web_who_loses: Rival mowing and vegetation-equipment makers (Deere, Toro, CNH, AGCO) and snow/street-sweeper competitors lose share as Alamo gains. Boxer-line employees and the Netherlands waterway vegetation unit face exit or closure (2026-09-08 SEC 8-K; 2026-08-04 call, aggregator).

web_did_they_deliver: Yes on manufacturing: Vegetation Adj EBITDA margin returned to 10 percent in Q2 2026, flat YoY, reversing H2 2025 disruption (2026-08-04 call).
